_note: Episode 10 keyframes, version 2 (Season 2 rules, 2026-11-12: about 5 minutes, multi-voice, at least 80 keyframes, action in every shot, varied framing, depth). Grown Indio: grey t-shirt, jeans, NO medallion, red handkerchief on wrist, arm tattoos (count not drawn). The boy (Indio at ten) has NO tattoos and NO medallion; the Lolo wears the family bronze medallion (sun and triangle). M wears her crescent-moon medallion. Teacher (GURO) and classmates (Bea, JM) are fictional and shown kindly. Real people (Marco, Scott, Pavón, the panel) appear only in frames copied from videos/kodigo-ni-kalantiaw (k04 chieftain, k09 teacher50s, k10 textbooks, k13 medal, k17 marco, k18 pavon_write, k19 manuscript, k20 archive, k21 scott_walk, k22 scott_glass, k23 crack, k25 pavon_cebu, k28 panel, k30 class80s, k31 stamp, k32 marco_night, k34 aklan), resized to 768x1344. Copied from Episode 8: full intro, full m_medallion_hot, chars usman_growl. Gamit of this episode: the Lolo's notebook in a tin under a loose stone at the foot of the school's marker (tin_stone, tin_open, notebook_page, notebook_glow). The free endpoint refuses prompts with the phrase 'Philippine public school classroom in 2012' and similar; use 'a bright classroom with wooden desks...'. Shot keys follow sentences.json (0-74); k80-k86 are extra keys used only in montages. Some earlier frames (indio_lens_modern, indio_soft, indio_resolve, m_silent, usman_happy, aklan) stay on disk but are not used in this version. No weapons.
